heading.html: What is a Korean Body Scrub Treatment?

children.text: A Korean body scrub is a traditional spa treatment that focuses on deep exfoliation and skin rejuvenation. This ancient technique uses a special cloth, known as a sesin, along with a carefully formulated scrub to remove dead skin cells, dirt, and impurities. The process promotes blood circulation, leaving your skin feeling soft, smooth, and revitalized. Often part of a holistic spa experience, the body scrub treatment at King Spa is designed to not only improve skin texture but also to relax the mind and body. This centuries-old practice, popular in Korean spas, offers a truly unique and effective approach to self-care, making it an essential treatment for those seeking a refreshing and cleansing experience. Experience this centuries-old technique at King Spa for a deep cleansing experience like no other.

children.text: Your treatment begins with a relaxing 15-20 minute soak in the hot tubs located inside King Spa’s gender-segregated bathhouse. The warm water helps to open your pores and relax your muscles, preparing your skin for the deep exfoliation to follow.

Next, our expert therapists use a special cloth called a sesin to gently exfoliate your skin. This traditional Korean technique removes dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and eliminates impurities, leaving your skin feeling smooth and refreshed.

After the exfoliation, your body is rinsed with warm water to remove any remaining scrub. A nourishing moisturizer is then applied to hydrate and restore the skin, leaving it feeling soft and rejuvenated.

heading.html: Benefits of the Men's Classic Body Scrub

children.text: This luxurious men’s spa treatment offers a wide range of benefits that go beyond just exfoliation. Here’s why this treatment is perfect for any man looking to rejuvenate both body and mind:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-11983116 womens-body-scrub active elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Deep Exfoliation
The primary benefit of a Korean body scrub is its ability to deeply exfoliate the skin, removing dead skin cells, dirt, and impurities. This results in smoother, softer skin and a noticeable improvement in texture and tone.
Improved Skin Health
By removing layers of dead skin, the scrub helps promote healthier skin. It unclogs pores, reduces the appearance of ingrown hairs, and can help minimize acne breakouts, making it ideal for those looking to improve their skin’s overall health.
Increased Circulation
The scrubbing technique used in the body scrub treatment stimulates blood circulation, which helps to nourish skin cells and give you a natural, refreshed glow. This circulation boost also supports muscle relaxation and a sense of rejuvenation.
Stress Relief
The soothing process of the scrub, combined with the tranquil spa environment, allows you to unwind and release built-up tension. It’s the perfect way to escape the pressures of daily life and experience a sense of deep relaxation.
Detoxification
The scrub helps to eliminate toxins and impurities from the body, leaving your skin feeling clean and refreshed. By promoting detoxification, the treatment can enhance your overall sense of well-being and help your body feel revitalized.
Better Absorption of Skincare Products
After the exfoliation process, your skin is more receptive to moisturizers and other skincare products, allowing them to penetrate deeper and deliver better results. This means your skin stays hydrated and nourished for longer.
A Refreshed Look and Feel
The combination of exfoliation, moisturization, and relaxation leaves you with skin that looks and feels refreshed, glowing, and healthier. It’s the perfect way to maintain your skin’s appearance and enjoy a relaxing experience.

Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.

children.html:
What is a Korean Body Scrub?

A Korean body scrub is a traditional treatment that uses a special cloth, called a sesin, to exfoliate the skin. It helps remove dead skin cells, dirt, and impurities while boosting circulation and promoting healthy, smooth skin.

Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

What do I need to wear for the treatment?

This treatment is traditionally performed in the nude to allow for the full exfoliation experience. Modesty will be respected as much as possible, and the treatment is conducted by skilled professionals in a comfortable environment.

How often should I get a body scrub?

For optimal results, we recommend getting a Korean body scrub once a month to maintain healthy skin and a refreshed feeling. However, it’s ultimately up to your personal preference and skincare needs.

Will the scrub help with skin conditions like acne or ingrown hairs?

Yes, the exfoliation process helps remove dead skin cells and unclog pores, which can reduce acne breakouts and help with ingrown hairs. However, if you have specific skin concerns, it’s always best to consult with your therapist before booking.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

How do I book the Men's Classic Body Scrub?

To book your Men’s Classic Body Scrub, please visit King Spa in person. Reservations must be made on-site to ensure availability and to customize your experience. Our staff will assist you in securing your appointment when you arrive.
